contents.text: Graduate students in a statistical mechanics course at Cornell University used a disease-transmission model to predict the rate at which a hypothetical zombie attack would spread throughout the United States. Because the spread of such an attack depends on numerous factors and could thus unfold in any one of a number of ways, the researchers used Gillespie dynamics, an algorithm that can simulate such stochastic events. The researchers found that cities would succumb quickly to the zombies, but the rate of infection would be much slower in more sparsely populated areas.

contents.text: The brain is a remarkably adaptable organ with an impressive capacity to reorganize its functions and pathways in response to experience. For instance, if a person becomes blind, the brain's visual cortex—which no longer receives any visual information—can be recruited to process other sensory input, like touch and hearing. This recruitment process explains why deprivation in one modality has actually been found to enhance the others. Similarly, a person who has suffered a permanent brain injury can often recover the ability to function normally: the brain can reallocate the processing power of healthy brain structures to compensate for the lost functionality in the damaged part of the brain.
What is the meaning of modality as used in the passage?

choices.text: a brain structure that has been "rewired" for a new function
a source of visual information
a main channel of sensation
a brain structure that is dedicated to a specialized function

contents.text: Proponents of virtual reality systems say that these new technologies have the potential to improve the quality of human lives. They note that virtual reality devices can allow people to enjoy new experiences without leaving their homes and can even facilitate cognitive rehabilitation in patients recovering from brain injuries such as strokes. Unfortunately, though, first-time users of virtual reality headsets often report experiencing nausea and headaches. Scientists have theorized that these symptoms occur because the visual input coming from the virtual reality device conflicts with a person's vestibular input. Many now believe that the solution to virtual reality queasiness lies in newer headsets that respond to head and neck movements, thereby giving users a visual experience that is more consistent with their sense of their changing physical position.
What is the meaning of vestibular as used in the passage?

choices.text: relating to auditory input
relating to the body's sense of balance and spatial orientation
relating to the body's sense of touch and tactile sensation
relating to external surroundings or environment

contents.text: Many ecosystems are threatened by invasive species—organisms that are not native to a region and damage the environment when introduced. For example, after arriving in North America, the purple loosestrife plant devastated wetland habitats by disrupting water flow and crowding out native species. Ecologists found, perhaps counterintuitively, that they could manage these infestations by introducing yet another exotic species to infested regions: Galerucella beetles, which are among purple loosestrife's natural predators. Of course, ecologists first had to determine that the beetles could become naturalized into the North American environment without causing further harm to the native ecosystem. Like other biological control agents, the beetles needed to be able to thrive well enough to maintain their populations long-term, but not so well that they would become invasive themselves.
